scope: Functional determinism evidence for the six declared per-tick streams and agreed start context on the supported browser route. This is not whole-world memory equivalence, retail equivalence, timing, performance, pixel, PCM, physical-input, or transport evidence.

applies_to_scenarios: Cold normal versus cold CPU x4
manifest_scope.earlier_scenario_note: These earlier captures used a prior frozen development build. Its served artifact manifest was not retained, so no 7eb5d89 artifact identity is claimed for them.

runtime_build.identity_note: Per-instance JSON does not embed a runtime build identity. For the cold normal, CPU x4, and full arena-fill captures, run-to-build binding uses the frozen served artifact manifest and post-capture HTTP verification; the four additional diagnostic imports were not hashed before capture.

workload.comparison_rules: Nonempty complete streams and complete instance metadata are required. Start-record agreement gates success separately. First object divergence and first gating-channel divergence are both reported. Results are covered only by the declared channels, not by a claim over all Results internals.

results.notes: This is a within-run repeated baseline using warm existing Chrome profiles; it is not the cold-profile result.

results.scenario: Cold normal versus cold CPU x4
results.orchestration: Separate sequential scenario runs and browser processes; not simultaneous playback.
results.raw_arena: At all five scene boundaries, base and size matched; the whole-region hash differed. The raw digest is auxiliary and differences were not localized.

At all five scene boundaries, base and size matched; the 32 MiB whole-region hash differed, establishing that the raw regions differ. The digest includes unclassified region contents; differences were not localized and establish no whole-memory equivalence or localized gameplay-state divergence claim.

negative_control.scenario: 1200-tick prefix with one input byte flipped at tick 1000

comparator_controls: Empty streams refuse comparison rather than passing as identical.
Failed or incomplete instance metadata refuses a positive comparison.
A mismatched agreed start context prevents success even when stream bytes match.
An earlier object mismatch remains the first divergence while a later input/gating mismatch is separately reported.
The flipped-input control reports its first mismatch tick.

lifecycle_and_diagnostics.timing_pause_recovery: The development-only harness checks native pause status, network active status as emitted by the native integer field, and owner paused/canPause state; recovery uses the owner resume lifecycle. The cold CPU x4 run recorded 352 successful resumes.
lifecycle_and_diagnostics.arena_fill_boundary: The one-shot fill is restricted to the pre-publication session arena boundary and refuses after session allocation/ownership has begun; it does not fill stack or unrelated memory.
lifecycle_and_diagnostics.browser_errors: A GET requestfailed event for gameplay_menu_browser.data with net::ERR_ABORTED is retained in request diagnostics. It did not prevent module/runtime readiness, native CSS startup, progress, or full-route completion. The abort origin is unproven; no path-specific exemption is asserted.
lifecycle_and_diagnostics.cache_scope: Profiles were cold-empty where stated. OS, GPU-driver and other host caches were not cleared or controlled.

build_and_tests.affected_target: runtime development build passed at runtime_build.source_revision
build_and_tests.retail_visitor_check: The fixed four-row Fighter fixture compares exact pre-change and post-change JSON bytes; this does not claim broader retail-state coverage.

retained_evidence.initial_e1: Retained separately as a startup failure with zero records after connection refused; it is not a comparison result.

not_claimed: FPS, wall-clock timing, latency, performance or foreground timing
